implementation: Ubuntu 22.04 OpenSSL Cryptographic Module (ECDSA SHA3 K/B)
description: Ubuntu 22.04 OpenSSL FIPS provider implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: ECDSA with SHA3 and K and B curves.
